harbor-rewardkit 0.1.7 source inside cw-editor-verifier:current (rewardkit/runner.py, judges.py, models.py, agents.py), read via docker run --rm
evidence: Parsed with tomllib (python -B): scoring.toml has [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; [weights] functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2 (sum 1.0); [floors] functional=0.05; each name maps to tests/gates/<n> or tests/scored/<n>, identical to the template. All five judge.toml have [judge] judge="claude-code" (matches REWARDKIT_JUDGE in task.toml:31), mode, timeout, isolated=false, prompt_template="prompt.md"; no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight keys; each declares the playwright MCP server with the template's exact args. Only scored/functional declares the second `verifier` server (command /usr/local/bin/python3, args ["/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py", "$APP_RESTART_HELPER"]), byte-identical to the template apart from a comment; test.sh:193 exports APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh" after generating it with heredoc+sed and chmod 755, and removes the .used marker (line 192) before both suites run (213, 224). Gates: aggregation all_pass, 1 binary criterion each. Functional: weighted_mean, 16 binary criteria, unique ids, weights 1.5-4.0 summing to 42.0 (matches the comment). Polish: 6 binary, weight 1.0. Visual: 4 likert points=5, weights 1.0/2.0. No empty descriptions, no duplicate ids. Every prompt.md exists, contains {criteria}, {app_context} and localhost:3000; test.sh:196-201 substitutes {app_context}, and RewardKit 0.1.7 judges.py:133 uses str.replace for {criteria} so the literal braces in app_context.md:24 (`async (page) => { ... }`) cannot break resolution. The one deviation from the template, functional mode="individual" (template: batched/9000), is a valid JudgeMode in RewardKit 0.1.7 (models.py:142 Literal["batched","individual"]); judges.py:451-465 registers MCP servers once (agents.py:66 expands $APP_RESTART_HELPER via os.path.expandvars) and then runs each criterion sequentially with the same prompt template and tool allow-list, and restart_mcp.py:29-32 enforces single use via an on-disk marker, so it holds across per-criterion sessions. Counterexample search: a broken app cannot pass through wiring (gates all_pass binary + floor); a conforming app is not failed by wiring (no unresolved placeholders, restart server present where needed). Not exercised by a full configured judge run (raw-evidence-index states none exists); the individual-mode budget arithmetic (16x550+900+900=10600 < 11100) and any retry multiplication belong to row 11, not this structural row.
